integrity: A complete mathematical lower-bound argument and an explicit upper-bound witness are supplied; the standalone verifier independently checks the finite tour optimum and witness.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for a four-symbol alphabet with fixed-point-free complementation and all sixteen length-four complement-tandem targets. An analogous larger-alphabet theorem is not asserted. Equivalent unindexed results remain a literature priority risk.
title: Exact length-26 cyclic cover of all four-letter complement-tandem DNA motifs
